## Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Minimal diff (≤ 300–500 LOC), only relevant files
- [ ] Ruff + Black pass in CI
- [ ] Pytest green (coverage ≥ 70%)
- [ ] i18n EN/PL parity check passes
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env` ignored)
- [ ] If schema changed: Alembic migration (up/down) + rollback notes
- [ ] Read and followed `docs/MASTER_PROMPT.md` & `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
